descriptionHtml:
Bug B25 · P1 · known

The Nursing Home dashboard counts every resident (22, should be the 19 In Today); a resident taken off In Today is still on it

Tickets: TFA-92587 AC6 ready for qa; TFA-92598 in progress · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-09/S09, TC-20/S04a, TC-20/S07

Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S06 Status × care setting → bucket, including the legacy and Note Ready states

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 The app counts every patient in Total and in exactly one of Pending (not yet prepped), In Progress and Complete, and shows the counts prominently (TFA-92598 How it works 1; TFA-92598 How it works 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Seeded: one Hospital patient for each of pending, pre-rounded, in-encounter, seen, note-ready, post-rounded; one Nursing Home resident (In Today) for each of pending, pre-rounded, in-encounter, note-ready, complete

When Open each care setting's dashboard

Then Every patient lands in exactly one bucket: Total = Pending + In Progress + Complete. Only 'pending' is Pending. Pre-rounded, in-encounter and seen are In Progress. Post-rounded and complete are Complete. Note Ready is recorded and judged after Q1

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Ticket rule 1 (every patient counted once; Pending = not yet prepped). counts Total 6 / Pending 1 (Hospital) and Total 5 / Pending 1 (Nursing Home) exact; tiles must add up to Total. In Progress is 3 or 4 and Complete is 1 or 2 depending on Q1: record both, judge after Q1. The prototype's own rule leaves Seen and Note Ready in no bucket, which fails the sum

Where it ran: datasets (seeded data sets, list checks) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev + local · tickets TFA-92598 in progress; TFA-92587 ready for qa

All four Nursing Home dashboard tiles (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) are counted over every resident instead of today's In Today list, so every number is too high.

Evidence: allure-results/440f2963…: NH buckets got 22/7/9/6, expected 19/6/(8/5 or 6/7). dev and local datasets are identical. Same root as S04a (counts taken over All Residents). Where Note Ready lands is only recorded (TC-20 Q1: Note Ready counted In Progress).

Duplicate: the same issue as TC-20/S04a; read that one (the kept one). This result carries the label "Duplicate", so a filter can leave it out.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane datasets (datasets/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/datasets.
